name: Default Keystrokes
description: Provides the canonical app keystroke verbs (app_save, app_print, document_open, window_new) as plugin verbs with inline-keystrokes shortcuts so they bypass the plugin RPC on the hot path.

verbs.name: app_save
verbs.description: Synthesize the focused app's save shortcut (defaults to ⌘S).

verbs.name: app_print
verbs.description: Synthesize the focused app's print shortcut (defaults to ⌘P).

verbs.name: document_open
verbs.description: Synthesize the focused app's open-document shortcut (defaults to ⌘O).

verbs.name: window_new
verbs.description: Synthesize the focused app's new-window shortcut (defaults to ⌘N).

topics.name: default-keystrokes
topics.title: Default Keystrokes
topics.summary: Plugin verbs for the canonical app shortcuts (save, print, open, new).
topics.body:
# Default Keystrokes

This bundled plugin owns the canonical app-shortcut verbs:

- `flash app_save` — ⌘S
- `flash app_print` — ⌘P
- `flash document_open` — ⌘O
- `flash window_new` — ⌘N

Each verb uses the manifest's `inline_keystrokes` table, so the host translates them directly into `input.send_key` without round-tripping through the plugin process. A future user-provided override could remap any of these per app — e.g. an Adobe app whose Save is on a non-⌘S chord — by listing the verb in their own plugin manifest with a per-bundle table.
